name: grimmsnarl_ml_v23
policy: V22 from own turn three onward; v8 teacher condition for own turns one and two; lexicographic route goals for opening attacker access and Alakazam backup continuity.

strategy.ordinary_policy: v22 ranker plus inherited one-ply arithmetic planner
strategy.opening_goal: Complete the first legal Grimmsnarl route before taking redundant Marnie-line pieces.
strategy.alakazam_goal: Build a second Grimmsnarl route by own turn five while the first attacker is ready.
strategy.tie_break: The active phase teacher's ranker score within goal-satisfying candidates.
strategy.matchup_detection: Visible Abra, Kadabra, or Alakazam on the opponent board.

policy_escalation.effective_runtime: No separate escalation under the default v22 code-0 phase; the inherited class definition remains recorded for reproducibility.

evidence.mirror_loss_pattern: All five losses lacked a Grimmsnarl ex on board by own turn two.
evidence.alakazam_loss_pattern: Two games had first attack on own turn four or five; another attacked on turns two through four then had four consecutive own turns without an attack.
concrete_route_examples: Episode 92626895 offered Rare Candy on own turn two with Grimmsnarl ex in hand but selected another card.
Episode 92641973 selected an optional Froslass piece while the only attacker had 20 HP and a visible Impidimp backup lacked its bridge.

teacher_forced_footprint.interpretation: Exposure upper bound on fixed v22 boards; repeated same-turn opportunities disappear after a live override changes the board.

submission_package.local_extracted_official_cg_import: TIMEOUT after 180 seconds on Windows; Kaggle archive uses the official cg bundle and source runtime was fully loaded by replay validation

known_limits: Teacher-forced replay can establish policy exposure and legality, not causal win-rate improvement.
The 44-game v22 sample is too small to establish a stable 1150 rating.
Alakazam specialization activates only after its evolution line is visible.
description: V23 phase-routed Grimmsnarl agent built from measured v22 ladder failures.
